summary: Close review for 2026-11-09. The one thesis that broke was BTC/USD: the PM sold it in full on the stored 10%-below-fill stop (11-06 close 74,756 vs about 75,317), and the 11-09 news fits that call (Bitcoin below $75k, below its 50-week average, ETF outflows jumping after the midterms, a Benzinga piece citing a possible drop to $67k-$69k). No exchange failed in the input, so the exchange-failure clause stayed untripped, as the PM stated (L5). The VNQ buy ($12 at 96.81) met no event risk: no VNQ headline or filing, and the only Real Estate-relevant news is the rate backdrop (December hike odds after the 165,000-job October report, inflation reports due this week). The held names had no 8-K 4.01, 4.02, 5.02 or large 1.01/2.01 in the window, and none has earnings inside 5 trading days (nearest WMT 11-19, KR 12-03), so L2 held. The unverified DPZ guidance-cut item (fiscal.ai, 10-30) is now ten sessions old with no 8-K and no second source, and today again brought nothing on DPZ. The tape's main new story was Nvidia's board probe of CEO Huang (NVDA down over 5% premarket), which hits QQQ/VOO/VTI sentiment more than any held single name.

broken_theses.why: Price stop tripped and the position was sold in full. The 11-06 close (74,756) was below the stored invalidation (10% under the 83,685.83 fill, about 75,317), and the 11-09 headlines agree: below $75k, lost the 50-week average, ETF outflows rising, Fear and Greed down after the midterms. The exchange-failure clause was not the cause: nothing in the input says Binance or any other exchange has failed (the Binance hack thread is stale). The sale's own invalidation (BTC closing back above about 80,000 within 5 sessions) is far from the headline levels cited today ($67k-$69k downside, $74.9k support), and the PM's wash-sale note says no rebuy before about 2026-12-09. Because the position is closed, the 11-11 MSCI crypto-treasury index decision is now sentiment context, not a held-position risk.
